d:
Gold slid below $3,500 an ounce as a selloff in stocks continued and a key inflation print reinforced bets on further Federal Reserve rate hikes. Bullion declined as much as 3.7% to $3,426.77 an ounce. A rout in gold has gathered pace recently, with the metal plunging nearly 9% last week, on track for a third straight monthly decline of more than 6%. Bloomberg's Mike McGlone joins to discuss.
